comment: Dracula. Source: https://github.com/dracula/dracula-theme (README.md, Color Palette). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Dracula Theme; the text is in LICENSE-dracula. Roles: text = Foreground, weak = Comment, rule = Current Line, accent = Purple, run = Cyan, ok = Green, error = Red, add = Green, remove = Red, tint = Selection, code = Current Line, background = Background. Dracula has no blue, so run is its cyan. The main palette names one selection/current-line colour and no second background, so tint is Selection #44475a and code is the editor interface's darker background BGDark #21222c from https://github.com/dracula/visual-studio-code (src/dracula.yml); the two differ, so a code block and a selected row do not look the same. No colour adjusted. cancelled = error with lightness 60% for a cancelled child's bar segment.
